object.description: Setup: a saved workout of at least 3 km. Steps: 1. With unit kilometre, open the workout and note Distance and Average pace. 2. Set the unit to mile and read both again. Expected: Distance in mi equals the km value divided by 1.609344 within 0.01. Pace in min/mi equals the min/km pace times 1.609344 within 1 s.
